slides.title: 1 — It has a nickname
slides.body: The moment the team *names* it, it's a system.

slides.title: 4 — Downstream depends on it
slides.body: "Fixing" it breaks a thing *you can't explain*.

slides.title: 5 — Nobody remembers why
slides.body:
The original problem is gone.
Only the *fear of removal* remains.

slides.title: 6 — It survived a redesign
slides.body:
The architecture changed.
The workaround got *migrated with care*.

slides.title: Promote it — or give removal a date.
slides.body:
Temporary is intent. Load-bearing is dependency.
What's the oldest "temporary" fix in your production path?
